articles.title: Georgia Prediction Markets: Best Promos and Apps in GA
articles.summary: Georgia just legalized sports betting, and the apps are already running sign-up bonus wars to grab market share. Early movers who lock in the best promos could save hundreds before the state's regulatory dust settles.

articles.title: Kyrie Irving NBA Trade Market on Kalshi Remains Low Despite Rumors
articles.summary: Kyrie Irving's name keeps floating around the trade rumor mill, but prediction market traders on Kalshi aren't exactly rushing to bet on a deal happening. That gap between gossip and actual market conviction usually signals either the rumors are overblown or the market is sleeping on a real opportunity.

articles.title: Are Prediction Markets the Future of Finance?
articles.summary: Prediction markets are getting pitched as the next big thing in financial infrastructure, with backers claiming they'll eventually replace traditional forecasting methods. If true, that means serious money flows into volume and liquidity for the platforms that nail user experience and regulatory compliance first.

articles.title: Polymarket Indicates 29% Chance Anthropic’s Market Cap Lands Above $1.5 Trillion
articles.summary: Polymarket traders are betting there's a 29% shot Anthropic reaches a $1.5T valuation, a figure that would put the AI startup in rarefied air alongside only Apple, Saudi Aramco, and Microsoft. That low probability reflects deep skepticism about whether Claude can actually convert hype into the kind of sustained revenue dominance needed to justify a valuation 3x higher than current unicorn pricing.

articles.title: Another U.S. appellate court goes against Kalshi, building the industry's legal headwinds
articles.summary: A federal appeals court just sided against Kalshi, the prediction market platform trying to get regulators off its back, adding another legal loss to its mounting pile. If courts keep ruling this way, the entire U.S. prediction market industry could stay locked out of mainstream adoption for years.

articles.title: Kalshi files to voluntarily dismiss its lawsuit against Louisiana
articles.summary: Kalshi, the CFTC-approved prediction market platform, is dropping its legal challenge against Louisiana's attempt to block the platform from operating in the state. The retreat signals that prediction markets still face real regulatory headwinds, even with federal blessing, and suggests other states will feel emboldened to push back without fear of costly litigation.

articles.title: Zohran Mamdani says prediction markets are troubling and 'degrade so much of life'
articles.summary: A New York state legislator is arguing that prediction markets commodify human outcomes in ways that are fundamentally corrosive to society. The comment signals growing political pushback that could translate into actual regulatory constraints on the industry just as it's gaining mainstream adoption.

articles.title: Polymarket Founder Says Trump Jr.’s Involvement Is ‘Heavily Overblown’
articles.summary: Polymarket's founder is pushing back on claims that Don Trump Jr. has significant influence over the platform's operations and decision-making. The clarification matters because regulatory scrutiny of prediction markets often hinges on perceived conflicts of interest, and any real or imagined political entanglement could invite unwanted attention from lawmakers already skeptical of crypto betting platforms.

articles.title: NBA adds Novig as its fourth prediction market partner - The Athletic
articles.summary: The NBA just brought Novig on as its fourth official prediction market partner, expanding the league's betting infrastructure beyond traditional sportsbooks. This signals serious mainstream acceptance of prediction markets and probably means more sports leagues will follow suit once they see the data flow and engagement these platforms generate.

articles.title: Trump admin orders Kalshi to halt wagers on what words Trump will say
articles.summary: The Trump administration ordered Kalshi, a leading prediction market platform, to stop offering contracts that bet on specific words or phrases the president will use in speeches or statements. It's the most direct regulatory attack yet on prediction markets and signals the administration views certain types of political wagering as off-limits.

articles.title: Kalshi Turns to Compute Desk in Renewed Push for GPU Futures
articles.summary: Kalshi, the regulated futures exchange, is partnering with Compute Desk to launch GPU futures contracts that let traders bet on graphics processor prices and availability. This fills a gap in the prediction market ecosystem since GPU costs directly move crypto mining profitability, AI infrastructure spend, and semiconductor supply chain bets.

articles.title: Kalshi bets on Martha Stewart to clean up its image
articles.summary: Kalshi, the prediction market platform that got nuked by regulators last year, is apparently trying to rebrand itself by partnering with Martha Stewart, betting her homemaking empire cachet can rehabilitate its image. If it works, it signals that prediction markets are finally shedding their casino stigma and moving toward mainstream legitimacy, which would actually matter for whether these platforms survive the next regulatory wave.
